title: HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the units associated with the property at 1341 North Fries Avenue: 1341 North Fries Avenue,…
text:
[Council File 26-0005-S197; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the units associated with the property at 1341 North Fries Avenue: 1341 North Fries Avenue, 1343 North Fries Avenue, and 1345 North Fries Avenue (Case No. 894798), Assessor I.D. No. 7420-005-012, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated October 27, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the units associated with the property at 1341 North Fries Avenue: 1341 North Fries Avenue, 1343 North Fries Avenue, and 1345 North Fries Avenue (Case No. 894798), Assessor I.D. No. 7420-005-012, from the REAP with the property to remain in REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
